description: Select a Siemens servo motor with its SINAMICS drive and cables for a given duty point, and return a ready-to-order bill of materials with complete order numbers, USD reference prices and a digit-by-digit explanation of the order numbers. Covers V90/1FL6, S200/1FL2, S200 Compact/1FL1, S210/1FK2 and S120/1FK7/1FT7/1PH8.

enc.description: encoder type: rel = incremental, mt_abs = multi-turn absolute, bat_abs = battery absolute

kw.description: rated power in kW, or a range like "1-2"

len.description: cable length in metres (default 10, max 50 for OCC)

rpm.description: rated speed rpm, or a range like "2000-3000"

top.description: number of candidates to return (1-10, default 3)

torque.description: rated torque N·m, or a range like "8-12"

name: select_servo
